accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: {n} accounts · manage credentials, proxies and today's usage
accounts.statusTooltipDisabled: Removed from the rotation queue; no requests are routed to this account
accounts.cliTooltipUnsupported: CLI calls are not supported for this account
accounts.cliTooltipDisabled: CLI is disabled on the server (ENABLE_CLI=false)
accounts.usableTooltipGlobal: Using the server-wide browser session; requests go through normally
accounts.usableTooltipNoSession: No browser session, so requests are rejected. Click "Generate" and the server signs in with this account's email and password and captures one automatically — no local Chrome needed.
accounts.usableTooltipDisabled: Disabled: no requests are routed here. Re-enable the account to generate a session.
accounts.provisionTooltip: The server signs in to chat.qwen.ai with this account's credentials and captures a browser session (~30–60s). No local Chrome needed.
accounts.confirmProvisionAll: Generate browser sessions for {n} accounts one by one? Each takes ~30–60s; keep this page open. Continue?
accounts.emptyHint: Add your first account and its status and today's usage will show up here.
accounts.emptyFilteredHint: Try another keyword or clear the status filter.
accounts.proxyInvalid: Invalid format: must start with http://, https://, socks5:// or socks5h://
accounts.batchLabel: Account list (one per line, format: email:password or email:password{'|'}proxy_url)
accounts.batchHint: Existing accounts are skipped automatically; malformed lines are ignored.
accounts.editProxyHint: Leave empty to clear this account's proxy and fall back to the global PROXY_URL.
accounts.detailHint: Credentials are loaded on demand and only shown in this panel.
accounts.confirmDeleteOne: Delete account {email}? This cannot be undone.
accounts.confirmDeleteSelected: Delete the {n} selected accounts? This cannot be undone.
accounts.confirmDeleteAll: Delete all {n} accounts? This cannot be undone!
accounts.confirmRefreshAll: Refresh tokens that expire within {hours} hours? Accounts that are not close to expiry are skipped; use "Force refresh" to refresh every account.
accounts.confirmForceRefreshAll: Force refresh the tokens of every account? This refreshes all accounts regardless of expiry and may take a while.
accounts.toastRefreshAllNone: No tokens expire within {hours} hours, nothing to refresh. Use "Force refresh" to refresh every account.
accounts.toastRefreshAllComplete: Refresh complete: {n} of {total} expiring accounts refreshed
accounts.toastToggleDisabledFailed: Failed to change the enabled state: {error}
accounts.toastProvisionFailed: Failed to create a session for {email}: {error}
